desc: Implement convolution-based counting: answer = sum over B in S of (c[2B]-1)/2, where c[2B] = # ordered pairs (x,y) in S with x+y=2B.
Correctness of reduction verified: self-pair (B,B) always present so c[2B] ≥ 1 and (c[2B]-1) is even; samples 1–3 produce 3, 5, 10.

Implement fast numpy FFT path: L = next power of two > 2*maxS (≤ 2^21), arr[S]=1, conv = irfft(rfft(arr)^2, L), np.rint to int64, then sum((conv[2B]-1)//2). Precision error ≪ 0.5 since coefficients ≤ N ≤ 1e6.
Implement pure big-int base-2^20 fallback (X = sum 2^(20x), P = X*X, extract 20-bit slot at byte 5B) with correct buffer sizing (xlen = 20*maxS/8+1, plen = 5*maxS+5).
Handle edge case n < 3 → print 0; numpy-missing fallback via try/except ImportError.
All 3 provided samples PASS; no further refinement needed since algorithm is optimal O(M log M) and both paths are verified correct.
